subject: Follow-up on study room bookshelf
text:
Hi Lena,

I wanted to follow up on the bookshelf we ordered together for the student study room. I realize we disagreed a little about whether the oak finish matched the filing cabinets, and I still believe the lighter tone would have looked less crowded.

That said, I appreciate your judgment about durability, and I do not want to dispute a practical choice. Could you let me know if the delivery date changed? If the current item arrives as scheduled, I will accept the arrangement and focus on placement instead.

Best,
Omar
